{"consolidated_memory":"billing/webhooks/stripe.py: Series of duplicate charge issues in webhook consumer

All incidents share:
- Location: billing/webhooks/stripe.py (billing side)
- Problem: duplicate charge in webhook consumer
- Signal: two ledger rows sharing one event id
- Repro method: redeliver the same webhook id twice

Four separate occasions with distinct root causes and fixes:

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-13]:
- Affected: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #1607 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 93 consecutive days before fix

OCCASION 2 [2026-04-08]:
- Affected: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #5587 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-2
- Result: backlog cleared 30 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 3 [2026-07-02]:
- Affected: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #5774 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-3
- Result: throughput rose 18 percent, reaching 45 requests per second

OCCASION 4 [2026-08-02]:
- Affected: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #8118 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-4
- Result: job finished in 39 minutes instead of 9 hours

All incidents occurred in the same corner of billing/webhooks/stripe.py, allowing context to carry over between fixes."}
